title: Watermelon Ice Geek Bar Pulse Disposable Vape
description:
Watermelon Ice Geek Bar Pulse Disposable Vape
With the Watermelon Ice Geek Bar Pulse 15000 Disposable Vape, discover a world of unmatched vaping bliss. This high-end gadget creates a perfect balance between amazing taste and state-of-the-art technology to provide an unparalleled sensory experience. The Geek Bar Pulse 15000, built for performance and ease of use, is an example of innovation in the vaping sector.
Long Battery Life
Every component, including the long-lasting battery and stylish appearance, has been painstakingly created to improve your vaping experience. This disposable vaporizer captures the essence of luxury with its delicious mix of ice freshness and watermelon, making every draw a journey in flavor and gratification.
Profile of Watermelon Ice Flavor
Juicy watermelon combined with a cool blast of ice creates a delicious taste profile known as Watermelon Ice. This enticing mixture delivers a rich, sweet taste with each breath, capturing the flavor of ripe, luscious watermelon. A sharp, energizing burst of ice freshness is then introduced by the exhale, resulting in a harmonic balance that awakens the senses.
Every pull is cool and delicious, with the first rush of fruity sweetness giving way to a lingering chilling effect. The Watermelon Ice flavor profile delivers the ideal fusion of cold and fruity sensations, making it ideal for those who want a satisfying and exciting vaping experience.
More Aspects:
Prefilled Capacity: 16mL
Battery Capacity: 650mAh
Charging Port: USB Type-C
Operation: Draw-Activation
Regular Mode Max Puffs: 15000
Pulse Mode Max Puffs: 7500
Nicotine : 5%
FAQ
What flavor does the Watermelon Ice Geek Bar Pulse 15000 offer?
It features a delicious blend of juicy watermelon and refreshing ice for a cool and fruity vaping experience.
What makes the Watermelon Ice flavor unique?
It combines the sweetness of juicy watermelon with a refreshing blast of ice, creating a harmonious balance of fruity and cooling sensations.
How does the pulse mode work on the Geek Bar Pulse Watermelon Ice?
Pulse mode increases the output and airflow to 20W, delivering denser vapor and a more intense flavor profile.
What type of coil is used in the Watermelon Ice Geek Bar Pulse 15000?
It uses an integrated dual mesh coil for consistent flavor and efficient vapor production.
